name: Furnaces of Hell (Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno), Advanced)

system.activation: An advanced version of Incinerate that engulfs many targets at once. Spend a Willpower Trait and make a mass Mental Challenge against Physical Traits, affecting as many targets as you have permanent Willpower Traits; anyone defeated suffers the effects of Incinerate, except the initial blast deals three levels of aggravated damage.
